purpose: Explain the language model as one coordinating layer inside an application so learners can see the instructions, sources, tools, memory, identity, permissions, and human controls around it.
staffSummary: Build M09 around one consequential utility situation and one decision: Identify which application components are required for a bounded utility task and which claims belong to the model versus the surrounding system. The learner must leave with a usable AI application architecture sheet, not a collection of definitions.
openingSituation: A demonstration appears to be one intelligent assistant, but its useful behavior actually depends on retrieval, tool calls, stored state, permissions, and review rules.
learnerDecision: Identify which application components are required for a bounded utility task and which claims belong to the model versus the surrounding system.
analogy: An operating system coordinates programs and devices, but it is not every file, application, user, or decision. A model can play a coordinating role without being the whole system.
